source: United Nations Statistics Division, Standard country or area codes for statistical use (M49), overview table
method: the English table of the page (id downloadTableEN), one row per country or area, keyed by its ISO-alpha3 code: M49 code, name, region, sub-region and intermediate region, as published
not_listed: M49 lists neither Taiwan (TWN) nor Kosovo (XKO), which inputs/cells/cell_countries.csv uses; model/results.py (cell_regions) gives them the region and sub-region of their neighbours: Asia, Eastern Asia and Europe, Southern Europe
